# Good Goblin

> > Good Goblin is an AI-powered college admissions platform helping students craft compelling essays and navigate the application process to top universities.

The platform provides comprehensive guides for Common App and university-specific applications, admission statistics for competitive schools, and AI-assisted essay writing tools. Resources cover everything from financial aid strategies to crafting personal statements for Ivy League and other selective institutions.

## Key Topics

- Common Application (Common App)
- College essay writing
- Admission statistics and requirements
- Application strategy (reach, target, safety schools)
- Test-optional policies
- SAT and ACT scores
- Holistic review processes
- Financial aid and FAFSA
- Personal statements and supplemental essays
- GoodGoblin AI editor
- Ivy League admissions
- UC Application and Personal Insight Questions
- Common Data Set
- AP and IB coursework
- Early action and restrictive early action (REA)

## Essay Writing Guides

- [Essays for College Admission to Get into Harvard University](https://www.goodgoblin.ai/blog/EssaysthatgetyouinHarvard): Harvard admission essay strategies and Common Application writing guide
- [Common App: Strategy for Success: College App Essay Examples](https://www.goodgoblin.ai/blog/CommonAppStrategiesforSuccess): Common App strategies with essay examples and Good Goblin AI editor tips
- [Discover What Makes the Best College Essays Stand Out](https://www.goodgoblin.ai/blog/TheBestCollegeEssays): Best college essay characteristics: authenticity, narrative, creativity
- [How to Write a Personal Statement for Scholarships](https://www.goodgoblin.ai/blog/PersonalstatementforScholarship): Scholarship personal statement writing tips with GoodGoblin AI assistance

## Application Strategy

- [Mastering College Selection – Perfect College Application List](https://www.goodgoblin.ai/blog/MasteringCollegeSelection): Balanced college list strategy: reach, target, safety schools with essays
- [Understanding Financial Aid: A Guide for College Applicants](https://www.goodgoblin.ai/blog/UnderstandingFinancialAid): FAFSA, Pell Grants, and financial aid application strategies guide
- [The Impact of Social Media on College Admissions](https://www.goodgoblin.ai/blog/SocialMediaCollegeAdmissions): Social media impact on admissions and online presence management tips
